extracts.context: You hear part of a discussion programme in which two journalists are talking about the world's wetlands.

questions.text: What does the man think about wetlands?

extracts.context: You overhear a woman showing a friend one of her childhood photos.

questions.text: What point is she making about the photo?

options.text: It is an accurate portrait of her family life then.

parts.title: Part 6
parts.instruction: You will hear a radio report about panic attacks. For questions 31-36, complete the sentences.
parts.passageContent:
People tend to have a panic attack when their brain tells them they are in a _____(31)_____.

The first sign of a panic attack is often an abnormal beating of _____(32)_____.

It may be useful to keep a diary of any _____(33)_____ you have so that you can analyse them.

You should not _____(34)_____ from places that cause you to panic.

If you tense and relax all your _____(35)_____ your whole body will actively relax.

Holding a _____(36)_____ to your face can help you breathe during an attack.
